verdict.rationale: Medusa's public GitHub repo states its core commerce modules are open source and freely available on npm, a community member notes the GitHub repo is MIT-licensed, and Medusa is listed among open-source SaaS alternatives. The repo's own OpenAPI spec also declares an MIT license. Missing for 10: a first-party citation of the repository's LICENSE file confirming MIT for the whole codebase, and recent independent corroboration (the MIT remark comes from an older HN thread).
